title: Chapter 105 — Purchasing, Programs, and Merchandise Planning
intro: How the floor gets stocked and the feedback loop into purchasing.

sections.title: The Feedback Loop
sections.content:
Salespeople are the closest to the customer. They know what customers are asking for, what is selling, and what is sitting on the floor collecting dust. That information is valuable to the purchasing team.

Provide feedback. When customers consistently ask for a product you do not carry, report it. When a display model is not selling, flag it. The stores that have strong feedback loops between sales and purchasing stock smarter floors.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating purchasing awareness, ask:

Does the salesperson provide feedback to purchasing about customer demand?
Do they understand how floor allocation decisions are made?
Are they contributing to smarter stocking — or just selling what is there?
